proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9530 subsection 7 *bhuṇḍa explicitly gives Gujarati bhũḍũ bad and Hindi bhũḍā ugly. The straightforward western Bhil/Marwari bhunḍ/bhuṇḍ bad forms match that specific family. Nasal transcription, vowel length and adjectival endings are retained and qualified. The separate pig/belly entries 9551/9531 and dental *bhunda 9532 were compared, not substituted. Local IA transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: bɦunḍũ.
